comment:
* The instances of this class encapsulate all the info
 * about enabled cipher suites and protocols,
 * as well as the information about client/server mode of
 * ssl socket, whether it require/want client authentication or not,
 * and controls whether new SSL sessions may be established by this
 * socket or not.

variables.name: defaultX509KeyManager
variables.comment: default source of X.509 certificate based authentication keys

variables.name: defaultX509TrustManager
variables.comment: default source of X.509 certificate based authentication trust decisions

variables.name: defaultParameters
variables.comment: default SSL parameters

variables.name: clientSessionContext
variables.comment: client-side SSL sessions

variables.name: serverSessionContext
variables.comment: server-side SSL sessions

variables.name: x509KeyManager
variables.comment: source of X.509 certificate based authentication keys or null if not provided

variables.name: pskKeyManager
variables.comment: source of Pre-Shared Key (PSK) authentication keys or null if not provided.

variables.name: x509TrustManager
variables.comment: source of X.509 certificate based authentication trust decisions or null if not provided

variables.name: enabledProtocols
variables.comment: protocols enabled for SSL connection

variables.name: isEnabledProtocolsFiltered
variables.comment: set to indicate when obsolete protocols are filtered

variables.name: enabledCipherSuites
variables.comment: cannot be customized, so for simplicity this field never contains any TLS 1.3 suites.

variables.name: client_mode
variables.comment: if the peer with this parameters tuned to work in client mode

variables.name: need_client_auth
variables.comment: if the peer with this parameters tuned to require client authentication

variables.name: want_client_auth
variables.comment: if the peer with this parameters tuned to request client authentication

variables.name: enable_session_creation
variables.comment: if the peer with this parameters allowed to cteate new SSL session

variables.name: endpointIdentificationAlgorithm
variables.comment: Endpoint identification algorithm (e.g., HTTPS)

variables.name: useCipherSuitesOrder
variables.comment: Whether to use the local cipher suites order

variables.name: ctVerificationEnabled
variables.comment: client-side only, bypasses the property based configuration, used for tests

variables.name: sctExtension
variables.comment: server-side only. SCT and OCSP data to send to clients which request it

variables.name: channelIdEnabled
variables.comment:
* Whether the TLS Channel ID extension is enabled. This field is
     * server-side only.

methods.comment:
* Sets the list of available protocols for use in SSL connection.

methods.comment:
* Sets the list of ALPN protocols.
     *
     * @param protocols the list of ALPN protocols

methods.name: void setApplicationProtocolSelector(ApplicationProtocolSelectorAdapter applicationProtocolSelector)
methods.comment:
* Used for server-mode only. Sets or clears the application-provided ALPN protocol selector.
     * If set, will override the protocol list provided by {@link #setApplicationProtocols(String[])}.

methods.name: ApplicationProtocolSelectorAdapter getApplicationProtocolSelector()
methods.comment: * Returns the application protocol (ALPN) selector for this socket.

methods.name: void setUseClientMode(boolean mode)
methods.comment:
* Tunes the peer holding this parameters to work in client mode.
     * @param   mode if the peer is configured to work in client mode

methods.name: boolean getUseClientMode()
methods.comment:
* Returns the value indicating if the parameters configured to work
     * in client mode.

methods.name: void setNeedClientAuth(boolean need)
methods.comment: * Tunes the peer holding this parameters to require client authentication

methods.name: boolean getNeedClientAuth()
methods.comment:
* Returns the value indicating if the peer with this parameters tuned
     * to require client authentication

methods.name: void setWantClientAuth(boolean want)
methods.comment: * Tunes the peer holding this parameters to request client authentication

methods.name: boolean getWantClientAuth()
methods.comment:
* Returns the value indicating if the peer with this parameters
     * tuned to request client authentication

methods.name: void setEnableSessionCreation(boolean flag)
methods.comment:
* Allows/disallows the peer holding this parameters to
     * create new SSL session

methods.name: boolean getEnableSessionCreation()
methods.comment:
* Returns the value indicating if the peer with this parameters
     * allowed to cteate new SSL session

methods.name: void setUseSni(boolean flag)
methods.comment:

methods.name: boolean getUseSni()
methods.comment:
* Returns whether connections using this SSL connection should use the TLS
     * extension Server Name Indication (SNI).
